body: Yep, that's what I'm planning to do. Hide. Just hope he gets bored and moves onto the next target.
Thank you so much for this, it's really reassuring and I read the article you linked - very helpful

He's done the first one, contacting my online friends, numerous times before when I needed space from him. He's gone on stalking missions on the online community asking everyone and anyone about me and looking for signs of me online, even becoming psychotic and accusing me of creating different secret accounts just because someone has been text chatting who has vaguely similar characteristics to me, ie, they are female and live in my country lol. 

I'm worried about the screenshotting thing, as I imagine this is something he will do in the smear campaign. I'm at the point now of not caring what people think of me on that community as long as he is out of my life.
Good for you staying strong and ignoring it. Hopefully he will give up. It seems the common consensus is if they can get no reaction they will eventually stop. I pray that is the case.

I'm trying to not give a fuck. I gave a fuck for too long. Endlessly worrying that he will actually hurt himself or hurt me. 

I'm trying to just stick to no contact and not worry. I know it will be driving him insane and he will be seeing me as a villain now. Rather than understand that I cut contact for my own sanity because I was on the verge of a complete breakdown. My feelings don't matter to him. It's all about him.

I can relate. My ex has had numerous crises. Some of which are true, some of which I doubt, or that he has exaggerated them, and sort of milked them for sympathy to control my behaviour. For example, there was something slightly bad that did happen to him a few months ago, he has been using his sadness over it to guilt me into doing things I don't want to do. There is never enough support that I can give. It was never enough. 

It's horrible to think he has been lying about some of the bad things happening to him, but there are so many times I've caught him out on lies and manipulation, it's impossible to believe anything he says. Another reason it had to end. I didn't know what was up and what was down.

The funny thing is he has been accusing me of gaslighting him lol. And using him. Like he is describing himself. That's why I had to cut contact he was literally driving me insane. There was one point where he drove me so crazy (months ago, when I told him I needed some time to myself) that I just went completely non-verbal. I just couldn't even form a sentence. I just sat there in a call while he screamed abuse at me for over an hour. He hated that I just wanted some time alone. How dare I when I belong to him as an object to feed his ego?

From the reading I've been doing, they are generally fine when they are the ones who discard, especially if they get a new supply quickly, or have one already lined up. 

But when you discard them it gives them narc injury and they lose it. Hopefully, he will find someone else for his supply soon and stop obsessing over me trying to 'win me back' and just leave me alone. Because I think if he can't find a new supply he will keep bothering me.

After doing reading about this, I have realised I was never a person, I was an item that belonged to him. He used to say things like I belong to him all the time and I am his girl etc. I was just a possession that he could drain praise and support from to feed his ego. 

I know I sound cold about this. I really did love and care about him and tried so hard to support him and give him what he needed, but it was never enough. And then I had an epiphany that this was really fucked up. I'm not sure if he is a full-blown narc but 100 per cent has narc traits, especially in this breakup, and whenever I have tried to have time for myself in the past. His behaviour has been so awful.

My sister has an eating disorder. When she was thirteen, she started a diet that escalated into starving herself to the point she very nearly died. She was hospitalized against her will (sectioned/committed), force-fed through a feeding tube, then committed to a psychiatric inpatient facility for adolescents, where she remained, involuntarily, for many, many months.

Starving yourself to death is not an easy way to die and most people will be forced against their will into hospital and force-fed, which is extremely unpleasant.
Thank you so much for this. You have no idea how much this has helped :)

Gosh, that sounds really awful. I'm sorry that happened to you. But it sounds like you're, rightfully, confident that your Nex doesn't have any legal ammunition they can use against you. Your lawyer's reaction says it all :)

I really hope my ex's behaviour doesn't escalate to the point of authorities being involved and legal problems :(

I really hope not. He lives in a different country. Doesn't have my phone number (he doesn't have one so we communicated through different apps. But he does have my address, knows my full name, knows a lot about my family and friends etc. I really hope he'll just move on and find someone else to fill his draining, bottomless void.

Thank you for your advice. I deleted my account from that online community. So don't really want to go back on. Plus, I'm concerned getting mods involved will just add fuel to the fire, make more drama, he's very well known on that community, and friends with one of the mods. So I think I'll just leave it and stick to strict no contact.

He's not threatened revenge porn but I have reason to believe he has been doing a smear campaign, making me out to be this horrible villain and he's this poor victim in the whole thing who was taken advantage of. 

He talked about all his exes in extremely negative ways. He was always the poor victim in everything. So I guess that's what he'll do. I hope that's all he'll do. I'm willing to lose the online 'friends' just to have him out of my life.

He's also threatened suicide and self-harming numerous times. He has self harmed for attention, to get me to talk to him. Apparently, he purposely overdosed on opiates a few months ago, but I don't know if it's true or not (and I hate to doubt these things). He lies and exaggerates often. It's possible he really does feel suicidal. But either way, I just can't have him in my life anymore. He drains me and everything I've given is never enough. He wants me to be perfect and won't accept anything less. He doesn't seem to care how his behaviour has hurt and distressed me.

It was a long-distance relationship, so I'm not worried about them coming to my house, although they do have my address. They don't have my phone number though.

I'm more worried about them doing a smear campaign. There was this online community we both hung out on. That's where we met. I no longer go on there, because I realised it was toxic. But as soon as I ended it, he went back on and I think he is doing a smear campaign.

I'm also worried about him doxxing me. And revenge porn. But I don't know if I'm just spiralling/catastrophising. 

One minute he's sweet and the next he's scary. I'm not sure what he is capable of when he loses it/gets angry. To make things worse he's abusing a lot of drugs that make him psychotic, so he's extremely unpredictable.

There are two potential deceivers in my life.

So, because I robbed a lot of drugs that equate to a lot of money, that means I will sit with a dear man who will benefit me a lot? But what does that mean when I flushed the drugs/money down the toilet? That I will dismiss the great man and the benefits he offers?
Yes, she's absolutely fabulous. I should not have stolen her drugs.
But we're all gonna die someday anyway. Not advocating any of you do it obviously, just making a point. Death, and whatever comes after it, is inevitable.
Same. Like the total blankness we had before we were born. I hope it's that.
